GOOGL.take: GOOGL: it is below its averages; the buy waits for a daily close above the 50-day average, the first sign the decline is over. Buyers are stepping in earlier (weekly), and support sits 2.3% below. Against it, the trigger has failed before. The desk stays out until the trigger proves the turn.
